title: Box the selling part
description: Draw a box around the part of a page that asks for money, a click, or a signup.
oneStarDescription: Point to the button, price, or sentence that asks you to act.
twoStarDescription: Draw one box around that part and leave the rest outside.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the text outside the box is still part of the offer.

title: Caption the change
description: Write a caption that says what changed, not how you feel about it.
oneStarDescription: Write one sentence that names the change.
twoStarDescription: Remove a word that only praises or complains.
threeStarDescription: Ask someone to point to the change from the caption alone.

title: Change one fold on a paper plane
description: Change one fold on a paper plane and say whether that flight went farther.
oneStarDescription: Fly the plane once and mark where it landed.
twoStarDescription: Change one fold only, fly again, and say which landing was farther.
threeStarDescription: Say one thing besides the fold that also changed, such as your throw.

title: Change one rule and play
description: Change one rule of a game you already know, play one short round, and say what the change did.
oneStarDescription: Write the old rule and the one rule you changed.
twoStarDescription: Play one short round with the new rule.
threeStarDescription: Say one thing players did differently because of that rule.

title: Check a strip at both ends
description: Cut one strip along a guide and measure the width at both ends.
oneStarDescription: Cut one strip using a ruler or a folded guide.
twoStarDescription: Write the width at each end.
threeStarDescription: Say whether the ends match closely enough for your use.

title: Check a walked distance
description: Walk a distance you estimated in paces, then check it against a known measure.
oneStarDescription: Write how many paces you think a short marked distance will take.
twoStarDescription: Walk it and write the paces you took.
threeStarDescription: Compare with the marked distance and say whether your pace guess was long or short.

title: Choose a closer thread
description: Choose a thread closer in color to a cloth than another thread, and say why.
oneStarDescription: Lay two thread colors on the cloth.
twoStarDescription: Pick the closer one and say the reason in the light you are using.
threeStarDescription: Look again in a different light and say whether you would still choose it.

title: Close a gap in the circle
description: Move your own chair so a person can join the circle without climbing over anyone.
oneStarDescription: Point to the gap a new person would need.
twoStarDescription: Move your own chair to open that gap.
threeStarDescription: Offer the seat and leave it if they refuse.

title: Compare two marks and stop
description: Say which of two marks looks sharper, and what you will not conclude about what made them.
oneStarDescription: Say which mark looks sharper or newer.
twoStarDescription: Write one conclusion you will not draw.
threeStarDescription: Write what the ground was like.

title: Compare two sets of hours
description: Compare the hours of two nearby services and say which one is open at a time you name.
oneStarDescription: Write both sets of hours from the signs or pages.
twoStarDescription: Name a time and say which service is open then.
threeStarDescription: Note one day one of them is closed.

title: Copy a maker's mark
description: Find a maker's mark on a tool or dish and copy only what you can see.
oneStarDescription: Point to the maker's mark on the object.
twoStarDescription: Copy the letters or picture you can see.
threeStarDescription: Leave a blank where the mark is worn, instead of completing it.

title: Copy an inscription and mark a doubt
description: Copy a short inscription and mark any letter you are not sure of.
oneStarDescription: Copy one short line as it appears.
twoStarDescription: Circle one letter or word you are unsure about and say why.
threeStarDescription: Show that you did not add a letter the stone does not have.

title: Copy an old spelling
description: Copy a historical name as printed, including a spelling you would not use now.
oneStarDescription: Copy the name letter for letter.
twoStarDescription: Do not modernize a letter in the copy.
threeStarDescription: On a separate line, write how you would spell it now, labeled as modern.

title: Count calls and write the place
description: Count calls for a short, stated time and write the place and the hour.
oneStarDescription: Write the length of time before you start.
twoStarDescription: Count the calls and write the number with the place.
threeStarDescription: If you hear two kinds, write them apart or say you did not separate them.

title: Count chairs against a list
description: Count the chairs and say whether a named list of people can sit.
oneStarDescription: Count the chairs that are actually in the room.
twoStarDescription: Count the names on the list.
threeStarDescription: Say how many seats are short or spare, and what you will do about one of them.

title: Cover a finished part
description: Cover a part you have finished so the next step does not mark it.
oneStarDescription: Point to the part that is finished.
twoStarDescription: Cover it with paper or cloth you may use.
threeStarDescription: Do the next ordinary step and then show the covered part is unmarked.

title: Cover the answer and try
description: Cover a worked answer, try the step, then uncover and compare.
oneStarDescription: Cover the result before you start.
twoStarDescription: Do the step and write your result.
threeStarDescription: Uncover and mark what differed.

title: Cut until the turn remains
description: Cut a short story until one turn remains, and read that version aloud.
oneStarDescription: Mark the sentence where the situation changes.
twoStarDescription: Remove sentences that do not lead to that turn or follow from it.
threeStarDescription: Read what remains and say what a listener still understands.

title: Describe a room by three sounds
description: Describe a room using three sounds, without naming an object you cannot hear.
oneStarDescription: Write three sounds you can hear from where you are.
twoStarDescription: Describe the room from those sounds and mark any object you did not hear.
threeStarDescription: Read the description and ask where they think you are, then say what they could not know.

title: Draw one landmark on the skyline
description: Draw a skyline and mark one landmark you could find again.
oneStarDescription: Draw the horizon you see.
twoStarDescription: Mark one building, hill, or tree you can name or describe.
threeStarDescription: From the same spot, point to that landmark using the drawing.

title: Draw the hand on the step
description: Draw a hand on an object to show one step of a task.
oneStarDescription: Write the step in one line.
twoStarDescription: Draw the hand where it actually goes.
threeStarDescription: Ask someone to copy the step from the drawing, and note where the drawing failed.

title: Drop a sheet and a crumple
description: Drop a flat sheet and a crumpled sheet of the same paper and say which landed first.
oneStarDescription: Drop it from shoulder height and watch the landing.
twoStarDescription: Crumple an equal sheet and drop it from the same height.
threeStarDescription: Say which landed first and one reason you would try again.

title: Ease an edge until cloth passes
description: Smooth one rough edge until a cloth passes over it without catching.
oneStarDescription: Pull a cloth across the edge and show where it catches.
twoStarDescription: Sand or file only that spot.
threeStarDescription: Pull the cloth again and stop when it passes.

title: Edit only the new page
description: Mark one page as finished and make the next change only on a new page.
oneStarDescription: Write that the page is finished.
twoStarDescription: Make the next edit on a new page.
threeStarDescription: Show the finished page without the new marks.

title: End on a picture
description: End a one-minute story on an image, not on a moral.
oneStarDescription: Tell a one-minute story with a clear last image.
twoStarDescription: Remove any last sentence that tells the listener what to think.
threeStarDescription: Ask what picture stayed, and do not replace it with a lesson.

title: Find a changed word
description: Find one word that differs between two editions or printings of the same short text.
oneStarDescription: Put the two versions where you can see the same sentence.
twoStarDescription: Mark one word that changed and write both words.
threeStarDescription: Write whether the change alters the sentence, or that you are not sure.

title: Find a number that changed
description: Find one number that differs between two versions of the same note.
oneStarDescription: Put two versions of one note side by side and mark the dates or labels.
twoStarDescription: Circle one number that differs and write both values.
threeStarDescription: Write whether you checked the rest, and do not claim a number you did not compare.

title: Find one change in an old photo
description: Name one thing present in both an old photo and the place now, and one thing gone.
oneStarDescription: Point to one feature you can see in both.
twoStarDescription: Name one thing in the photo you cannot see now, or the reverse.
threeStarDescription: Mark one thing you are not sure is the same place.

title: Find where a form goes back
description: Find where a form should be returned, from the form itself.
oneStarDescription: Point to the line that says where it goes.
twoStarDescription: Copy the address, box, or office as written.
threeStarDescription: If the form does not say, write that you would ask before sending it.

title: Find which date is which
description: On one page, say which date is the event and which date is the publication.
oneStarDescription: Write every date you can see on the page.
twoStarDescription: Label one date as the event and one as the publication, or say the page does not show both.
threeStarDescription: Say which date you would cite if you mentioned the event.

title: Fold a paper span
description: Span a gap with paper and add one fold so a light object can sit on it.
oneStarDescription: Lay a flat sheet across a small gap and see it sag.
twoStarDescription: Add one fold or pleat and try the same light object.
threeStarDescription: Say how wide a gap you would not try with this sheet.

title: Fold a scarf so the ends meet
description: Fold or hang a scarf so the ends meet where you intended.
oneStarDescription: Say where the ends should meet.
twoStarDescription: Arrange the scarf so the ends meet there.
threeStarDescription: Move, then fix the ends if they slipped.

title: Follow a brush label or stop
description: Clean a brush only in the way its label describes, or stop if there is no label.
oneStarDescription: Find the care line, or write that there is none.
twoStarDescription: Follow that line, or do nothing if it is missing.
threeStarDescription: Write one cleaner you did not use because the label did not name it.

title: Follow a repeat mark
description: Follow a printed repeat on a simple line of music or a rhythm line, and stop where it says.
oneStarDescription: Point to the repeat mark.
twoStarDescription: Do the line again where the mark says.
threeStarDescription: Stop at the place the line now ends.

title: Give a character one want
description: Invent a character with one want and one obstacle, then play that for one minute.
oneStarDescription: Write one thing the character wants.
twoStarDescription: Write one obstacle that is not another new power.
threeStarDescription: Play or tell one minute in which the want meets the obstacle.

title: Give pairs one question
description: Pair people who have not already been talking, and give them one question.
oneStarDescription: Make pairs and say how you chose them.
twoStarDescription: Give the same question, written so they can read it.
threeStarDescription: Stop the pairs at the time you named.

title: Hand over the next line
description: Stop your sentence and let the other person say the next line of a made-up scene.
oneStarDescription: Say one line that leaves room for a reply.
twoStarDescription: Stop before you answer your own line.
threeStarDescription: Continue from the line they actually said.

title: Hang a bundle where air reaches
description: Tie a small bundle of herbs or flowers so air can reach it, and hang it where you said.
oneStarDescription: Tie the bundle so you can see gaps.
twoStarDescription: Write where it will hang.
threeStarDescription: Hang it in that place and show the gaps are still open.

title: Invite the quiet person once
description: Invite a person who has not spoken, once, and accept it if they do not take the turn.
oneStarDescription: Offer the turn once by name.
twoStarDescription: Leave a pause long enough for an answer.
threeStarDescription: If they do not speak, continue without a second push.

title: Keep an original unchanged
description: Save a copy under a new name and show that the original file or page did not change.
oneStarDescription: Write the name of the original.
twoStarDescription: Save the copy under a different name.
threeStarDescription: Open the original and show a mark you did not add.
